rawRecord.name: Veridict
rawRecord.short_description: Runtime verification layer that monitors tool execution and provides trust judgments based on success rate metrics.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Wraps server tool handlers to log execution data including input/output hashes, success/failure status, and latency. Persists execution history in a local SQLite database and calculates trust verdicts based on configurable success rate thresholds. Provides statistics and trust assessment tools that agents can query to evaluate server reliability before delegating tasks.
